title: The 8 Best Dado Set for Table Saw 2026
h1: The 8 Best Dado Set for Table Saw 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for dado set for table saw 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dado set for table saw 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Freud SD508 8-Inch Super Dado Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch diameter, 24-tooth outer blades, TiCo carbide.
strengths: TiCo carbide produces the flattest groove floor of any dado set in the test -- no ridges
Shim set allows exact dado widths from 1/4 to 29/32 inch
Thin-kerf outer blades minimize waste and reduce motor load
The most commonly recommended dado set by furniture and cabinet woodworkers
limitations: 8-inch diameter requires 10-inch saw with 5/8-inch arbor and sufficient arbor thread length
Higher price than budget dado sets
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Freud SD208S 8-Inch Pro Dado Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch diameter, 12-tooth outer blades, TiCo Hi-Density carbide crosscutting blend, Optimized for SawStop, Jet, DeWalt, Bosch and other underpowered saws.
strengths: Freud is the reference brand for dado carbide quality -- the SD208S delivers the same TiCo carbide in a lower-cost 12-tooth package
Lower tooth count and reduced RPM rating make it easier on underpowered contractor saws and SawStop brake-equipped saws
Flat-top grind produces a flat groove floor without ridging
Provides Freud-level cut quality at a lower price than the SD508
limitations: Max RPM is lower than the SD508, so it is not ideal for high-RPM cabinet saws
Fewer shim configurations than the Freud SD508
features: Optimized for SawStop, Jet, DeWalt, Bosch and other underpowered saws
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: DEWALT DW7670 8-Inch Dado Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch diameter, Carbide-tipped, Includes 5 chippers.
strengths: DeWalt quality control ensures consistent carbide geometry across the chipper set
5-chipper configuration covers the widest range of dado widths
Compatible with DeWalt, Bosch, and most other 10-inch saw arbors
DeWalt brand recognition means accessible service and replacement parts
limitations: Carbide quality is below Freud TiCo
Groove floor is slightly less flat than Freud or Diablo

products.name: IRWIN Tools 1811865 Marples 8-Inch Stacked Dado Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch diameter, Budget price, Includes chippers and shims.
strengths: Lowest price for a functional stacked dado set
Adequate for dado work in pine, poplar, and plywood
Good starting set for new woodworkers learning dado joinery
Covers all basic width requirements
limitations: Carbide dulls noticeably faster in hardwood than Freud or Diablo
Groove floor is less flat than premium sets -- may show ridging
Chipping on plywood edges more common than with premium carbide
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Forrest DK08244 Dado King 8-Inch Dado Set
products.blurb: Key specs: American manufactured, Flat-top grind chippers, 8-inch diameter.
strengths: The Forrest Dado King is the benchmark for dado set cut quality -- used in professional cabinet shops
American manufactured with the highest available carbide quality
The flattest groove floor of any dado set -- zero ridging at any width configuration
Forrest offers a sharpening service -- the set can be maintained for decades
limitations: The most expensive consumer dado set available
Sharpening service adds ongoing cost for heavy users
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: CMT 230.012.08 Orange Tools 8-Inch Dado Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Orange colored body, Micro-grain carbide, Anti-kickback design.
strengths: CMT micro-grain carbide is harder than standard carbide -- better edge retention
Anti-kickback body geometry on all chippers reduces catch risk
Italian manufactured with precision that matches Freud in groove floor quality
5-chipper configuration provides complete width coverage
limitations: Less common in North America -- fewer local dealers
Price is between Diablo and Forrest

products.name: Oshlun SDS-0842 8-Inch 42-Tooth Stack Dado Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch diameter, Carbide-tipped, Multiple width shims.
strengths: Noticeably flatter groove floor than budget sets
Good for hardwood dado work in moderate volume
The step up from Irwin for woodworkers who work in hardwood regularly
limitations: Still below Freud TiCo carbide quality
Less commonly reviewed -- fewer comparison data points available
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: SawStop BTS-DS8-2402 8-Inch Premium Dado Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch diameter, 24-tooth outer blades, Micro-grain carbide, Wide 1/4 to 29/32-inch width range with shims.
strengths: SawStop-engineered geometry provides reliable brake-cartridge compatibility on SawStop saws
Covers 1/4 to 29/32-inch groove widths with included shims
Also compatible with standard 5/8-inch arbor table saws from other brands
Better than budget carbide at a mid-range price
limitations: Carbide quality is below Freud TiCo
Groove floor slightly less flat than Freud or Forrest
features: Wide 1/4 to 29/32-inch width range with shims
Engineered for SawStop brake-equipped saws (also fits other 10-inch saws)
